My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)

It is an odd doubt, but I am not sure whether it was you or [Mr Craik](/person/379) who wrote to me about writing a History to suit that proof. Am I to understand that I may take [the wars](/book/126) of the Castilhians [sic] and Moors, for I should like to make it my winter work

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
